source.note: No automated match, priority, or contextual note constitutes acceptance of a Mandarin meaning or emoji.

criteria.high: Seven substring-only false positives plus previously manually flagged high-priority cases
criteria.unclassified: All other whole-term discrepancies; priority not independently assessed
criteria.deskAnalyzedUnclassified: Assistant source-grounded desk triage; remains unclassified for independent review and never counts as lexical verification.

deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ke3: uneven (path);  unfortunate (in life);

deskAnalysis.observation: The independent dictionary gives unburnt earthenware or blank, contradicting the dam interpretation; 🌊🧱 should be withheld for this usage.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: pi1: blank (e.g. for a coin);  unburnt earthenware;  semifinished product;  Taiwan pr. [pei1]

deskAnalysis.observation: Pull up or out supports uproot in plant contexts, but 🌱 depicts a seedling without removal.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ba2: to pull up;  to pull out;  to draw out by suction;  to select

deskAnalysis.observation: Plain or area measure fits level ground, but 🟩 merely depicts a green square.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ping2: a plain;  ping, unit of area equal to approx. 3.3058 square meters (used in Japan and Taiwan);

deskAnalysis.observation: Mortgage or pawn can be a pledge, but 📝 represents signing rather than security or custody.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ya1: to mortgage;  to pawn;  to detain in custody;  to escort and protect

deskAnalysis.observation: The -er or one who suffix is a grammatical operator, not a group of people; 👥 hides the nominalization function.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: zhe3: (after a verb or adjective) one who (is) ...;  (after a noun) person involved in ...;  -er;  -ist

records.referenceDefinition: to break up, split apart, rip open

deskAnalysis.observation: Tear apart, open or demolish is physical; 💔 signals emotional heartbreak instead of splitting a material object.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: chai1: to tear open;  to tear down;  to tear apart;  to open

deskAnalysis.observation: Embrace is an explicit sense, but 🫂 does not convey gather, support or surround alternatives.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: yong1: to hold;  to embrace;  to wrap around;  to gather around (sb)

deskAnalysis.observation: Capture or restrain overlaps detain; 🔒 symbolizes locking and may miss custody or restriction without a lock.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ju1: to capture;  to restrain;  to constrain;  to adhere rigidly to

deskAnalysis.observation: The standalone headword refers to 垃圾 as a compound; 🗑️ is a word-level waste cue, not yet evidence for an independent glyph usage.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: la1: see 垃圾[la1 ji1];  Taiwan pr. [le4];

deskAnalysis.observation: Draping over shoulders is narrower than wearing clothes; 👕 depicts a shirt rather than the action of draping.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: pi1: to drape over one's shoulders;  to open;  to unroll;  to split open

deskAnalysis.observation: Allocate or set aside funds differs from distributing objects; 📤 depicts outgoing transfer, missing resource assignment.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: bo1: to push aside with the hand, foot, a stick etc;  to dial;  to allocate;  to set aside (money)

deskAnalysis.observation: The source distinguishes snapping a bend and stubbornness by reading; ➰ signals a curved shape without either action.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: ao4: variant of 拗[ao4];  to bend in two so as to break;  to defy;  to disobey | niu4: stubborn;  obstinate;

deskAnalysis.observation: Former times or the past overlaps ancient but not necessarily remote antiquity; 🏺 emphasizes archaeological artifacts.
deskAnalysis.sourceExcerpt: xi1: former times;  the past;  Taiwan pr. [xi2];
